data.name: Rasek
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

Become a part of Rasek's development!

We are just getting started, and we want to build this game with you. We are relying on your feedback to help shape what comes next. Expect continuous Early Access updates featuring new areas, quests, skills, crafting, an Arena mode, and more.

Join the conversation on Discord and help us build something amazing.


About the Game

Welcome to the land of Rasek, a place ravaged by the curse of the great master of magic, Eclor.
In Rasek you will be able to:

  • Discover a massive, lore-rich handcrafted open world.

  • Experience dynamic day/night cycles and immersive weather effects.

  • Team up in 4-player Raid Dungeons.

  • Take on thrilling quests, hunts, and minigames for rare loot and treasure.

  • Unlock rewards through an extensive Achievement System.

  • Battle a rich variety of enemies and conquer colossal ancient bosses.

  • Clash with other players in open PvP, or challenge them in a 3v3 Arena.

  • Forge a clan with friends and declare war on your rivals.

  • Choose between 4 unique classes to match your playstyle.

  • Craft unique builds by mixing and matching equipment with distinct attributes.

  • Express yourself by crafting items, customizing your cosmetics, and decorating your own home.

  • Unravel the epic story of Rasek.

  • Experience a living world. Participate in live in-game events.

  • ...and become the realm's most famous warrior!

Explore Rasek’s territory across deserts, forests, caves, and more in search of resources and equipment to strengthen your character. Embark on limited-time seasonal missions and maps that make the rewards even rarer. Battle challenging monsters and claim daily prizes as you play.



Use the resources you gather to upgrade your gear and return to battle even stronger. Discover a variety of item types and rarity tiers, including even more powerful ones, and boost your chances of obtaining rarer loot using special catalysts.


Increase your health, magic, speed, damage, and other stats through a level-based progression system, whether by defeating enemies, crafting items, or completing quests. Develop specialized abilities in a talent tree as your character grows even more powerful.

And why fight alone? Team up with other players to explore, farm, engage in combat, take on raids, and even tackle missions with your squad’s support. Join a clan, combine forces, and wage war against rivals in PvP zones to earn items, XP, and badges.

Become part of Rasek and forge your legacy. Will you be a respected legend or a feared rival? The path is yours to carve.

data.short_description: Experience the glory and adventure of old-school online RPGs in this pixel art action MMORPG. Choose your class, customize your skills, battle with a clan or travel alone, play your way and fight to become a legend in Rasek.
data.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: x64 com SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 (DX11) compatible — any 2012+ GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required to play
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core (i5 / Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required to play
